## ICluster interface

Membership callbacks a clustered queue hands to a [ClusterManager](/api/core/latest/core.clustermanager/) so the manager can add and remove servers as it discovers them.

Implement this to feed a clustered queue from your own discovery mechanism; [ClusteredRedisQueue](/api/core/latest/core.clusteredredisqueue/) supplies an implementation of its own.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ICluster 
```
